assertions.name: tau_M_compositions_differ_from_canonical
assertions.source: F1 hypothesis 3: if compositions disagree, Model B mapping has structural ambiguity (per 2026-05-15-three-pr-integration.md)

description: ⁴He compositional consistency probe per F1 question 3 (integration audit 2026-05-15-three-pr-integration.md). Compares τ_M(⁴He canonical) against three disjoint Markov compositions (D⊕D, T⊕p, ³He⊕n).  Result: all four DIFFER by 50-300% — Markov disjoint product is not the right compositional notion for ⁴He, which requires INTER-COMPONENT INTERFACE generators (the canonical pppnnn ordering).
caveats: This probe tests at the Markov-trace level only.  A full JSJ closure reduction (per F1 questions 1-2) would compute the actual hyperbolic / Seifert decomposition pieces of each composition's link closure and compare topologically.  That requires SnapPy / Regina topology tools; deferred.

Markov disjoint product τ_M(β_1 ⊕ β_2) = τ_M(β_1) · τ_M(β_2) only when the strands are truly disjoint (no shared bridge generator).  For ⁴He compositional purposes, the right construction is INTERFACE-based concatenation: β_⁴He = β_X · I · β_Y where I is one of {I_pp, I_pn, I_nn} at the X|Y boundary.  Each compositional choice gives a DIFFERENT braid word in H_12 with its own τ_M and topology.
